name: Ubahni Militant (CR 1/2)
body:
UBAHNI MILITANT
CR 1/2

This reptilian humanoid has thick, leathery red scales dotted with spiky, misshapen growths.

XP 200
Ubahni barbarian 1
CE Medium humanoid (reptilian)
Init +1; Senses Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 9, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +3 armor, -2 rage)
hp 18 (1d12+5+1)
Fort +7, Ref +1, Will +2; +2 vs. radiation
Defensive Abilities mountaineer; Immune low-level radiation; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bardiche +6 (1d10+7 S, 19-20/×2; brace, reach, sunder) or 2 claws +6/+6 (1d4+5 B&S)
Ranged javelin +2 (1d6+5 P, range incr. 30 ft.)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bardiche)
Special Attacks rage (7 rounds/day)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 12, Con 20, Int 8, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +6; CMD 15
Feats Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+8 to jump), Climb +12, Perception +4, Survival +6; Species Modifiers +2 Survival
Languages Common, Ubahni
SQ rock stepper, subspecies (red ubahni)
Gear NPC gear (studded leather armor, bardiche, 6 javelins, other gear)

BASE STATISTICS

When not raging, the barbarian has the following statistics:
AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14; hp 16; Fort +5; Will +0; Melee bardiche +4 (1d10+4, 19-20/x2) or 2 claws +4/+4 (1d4+3); Ranged javelin +2 (1d6+3); Str 17, Con 16; CMB +4; CMD 15; Skills Climb +10.

ABOUT

Ubahni are reckless and hard to manage. Nevertheless, they are eager to escape the irradiated wasteland of their homeworld, so they often seek employment throughout the Galaxy as mercenaries, guards, and bounty hunters.
